selection_rationale: Top-tier CMS-platform skill in the target category with clear overlap on collections, hooks, access control, local API, and custom endpoints.
Can be exercised inside one container with local SQLite storage and without external accounts, store backends, or private workspaces.

Depends on workspace tokens and private content permissions, which do not fit this task family.
Platform-specific automation helper rather than a CMS build workflow.
